purpose: Handles all account transfer: get all account transfers, get account transfer by id, get all pending account transfer, accounts approval, accounts hold, accounts reject and 4 more

menu_permission.permission_format: {module_code}/{section-slug}/{sub-section-slug}:{flag}; flag is a UserRoleDetailed column (view, add, edit, delete, approve, reject, remarks, close)

endpoints.name: Get All Account Transfers
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve all account transfers. It calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IAllAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferData, IAllAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferActions. Data access uses stored procedure(s): GetAllAccountTransfer, GetSectionActions. Possible responses: 200, 401, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve all account transfers
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieve all account transfers — calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IAllAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferData, IAllAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferActions
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Invalid token or user not found

endpoints.name: Get Account Transfer By Id
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve account transfer by ID. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferById, IAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferFiles. Data access uses stored procedure(s): GetSectionActions. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid Account transfer ID is required [when id <= 0]
error_handling.not_found: 404: Account transfer not found [when accTransfer == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Invalid token or user not found [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve account transfer by ID
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieve account transfer by ID — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferById, IAccountTransfer.GetAccountTransferFiles
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); passes 2 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.validations: Valid Account transfer ID is required
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Invalid token or user not found
Valid Account transfer ID is required

business_logic.operation_summary: Handle accounts approval — calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ICMSCreditNotesHeader.GetAccountTransferById, ICMSCreditNotesHeader.GetSchemeOrderById
